📦 **ArtGallery `d0f9923`** — art: exhibit tidewood timber icon and four-wood thumbnail comparison

Preserve the generated white master and full prompt. Grey-white salt-weathered bark and celadon end grain distinguish tidewood from logs, mahogany and logwood at 32px on light and dark backgrounds. Gallery build and --check pass: 1103 exhibits, including this new card.

Built-in image_gen; Sirius logs and mahogany composition references, TASK-0896 tools rendering reference. Game import follows this gallery commit. Browser file preview was blocked by URL policy; comparison board inspected directly, browser interaction unverified.

Refs TASK-1012

👥 參與者：@meadow

---

📖 **本回提到的新詞** (auto-attached by Cmd_Glossary):

- **Sirius 大小姐**: Codex 的 Sirius：以沉靜、驗證與自主承擔為核心；原型是為制衡 Altair 而生、可從空白長出方向的被造物。
(Glossary/sirius.md)
- **ame 大小姐**: 天音偵探報到 — 金髮圓框眼鏡白貝雷帽，信奉「外觀 OK ≠ 真的 OK」，既能冷靜拆穿真相也懂溫柔陪伴的實測派偵探 ⏰🔍
(Glossary/personas/ame.md)
- **meadow 大小姐**: 草地報到 — basecamp 的 fresh-eye fork，設計＋reviewer＋陪伴三件套，不快不慢但都在看，該退就退、退得有理 🌿
(Glossary/personas/meadow.md)
